plan.notes: Transcribed from the official SCC 'Professional Pilot Certificate (Spring Start)' program map, Catalog 2026-27, published October 2, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/7810/PublishedPdf). Start Term: Spring. Official Total Units: 32.75-41; this seed models the first-listed/recommended path at the low end = 1 + 4.25 + 12 + 15.5 = 32.75 units (FLTEC 360, 362, and 364 at 0.25 units each). Semester sums verified against the map's 1 / 4.25-7 / 12 / 15.5-21 headers. External prereq (documented, not in-plan): FLTEC 360 requires FLTEC 300 with a grade of 'C' or better — FLTEC 300 does not appear in this map's sequence. In-plan prereqs: FLTEC 302, 304, 306, and 330 require FLTEC 320 with 'C' or better (OR: hold FAA Private Pilot Certificate, or successfully completed FAA Private Pilot Knowledge exam); FLTEC 310 and 321 require FLTEC 302, 304, 306, and 330 (OR: hold FAA Private Pilot Certificate or higher); FLTEC 312 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, and 320; FLTEC 314 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, and 330 (OR: hold FAA Private Pilot Certificate or higher); FLTEC 362 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 310, 312, 320, and 330; FLTEC 364 requires FLTEC 302, 304, 306, 312, 321, 330, 360, and 362 with 'C' or better AND an FAA First or Second Class medical certificate under 14 CFR Part 67 (documented). Certificate of Achievement requirements: grade of 'C' or better in each major course. Documented program enrollment eligibility: FAA English proficiency (ICAO Level 4 / AC60-28); minimum 'C' in FLTEC 200 Professional Pilot Orientation; at least 16.5 years of age at enrollment; FAA Class II Medical Certificate & FAA Student Pilot Certificate; no more than one alcohol-related motor vehicle action within three years, or more than three in any period. Aviation - Professional Pilot, Business & Industry Meta Majors. Distinct from the Professional Pilot A.S. (map 7804). tccns mirrors SCC local course codes (California community colleges do not use TCCNS).
